skill.name: whatsapp-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with WhatsApp or needs help summarizing and organizing chats, drafting replies, exporting history, creating Status or business content, configuring Business features, sending compliant notifications, or managing devices and backups. Routes each workflow among My Browser, WhatsApp Desktop through Computer Use, native content tools, file processing, and official WhatsApp features.
skill.userDescription: Summarize, organize, export, and manage WhatsApp chat and business workflows.
exampleQuestions: Summarize action items from my exported WhatsApp chat.
Draft a WhatsApp Business Status for review.
Help me organize a WhatsApp chat export.
